2610.06715.title: Domain adaptation of Russian ModernBERT for long legal documents
2610.06715.paper_summary: We investigate whether continued pretraining on Russian legislative documents improves a Russian ModernBERT encoder on legal text. The adapted model, RuModernBERT-ruLaw, was trained on a corpus reported to contain 304,382 legislative documents and 194,425,905 corpus tokens. Corpus token counts are distinguished from positions produced by the model tokenizer. We compare the original and adapted encoders on a fixed external collection of 1,031 court-decision segments. Both models receive the same hidden positions in each of five masking realizations. At maximum input lengths of 512, 2,048, and 8,192 tokens, mean masked-token cross-entropy decreases by 0.10942, 0.07052, and 0.06604 natural-log units, respectively. The reported 95% intervals summarize sensitivity to masking on this fixed collection; they do not quantify uncertainty across document collections. A second evaluation addresses legal-entity extraction. The original and adapted models achieve entity-level F1 scores of 0.99852 and 0.99820. However, 99.95% of test spans have the same normalized surface form and class in the training split. This evaluation therefore provides limited evidence about transfer to previously unseen forms. The paper explains the masking objective, overlapping windows, averaging rules, and exact entity-boundary scoring using editable diagrams and clearly marked illustrative examples. The comparison supports lower masked-token prediction loss for the studied pair of models and collection. It does not isolate the contribution of distant context or establish practical legal utility.
2610.06715.paper_summary_zh: 我們調查持續對俄羅斯立法文件進行預訓練是否能改善俄羅斯 ModernBERT 編碼器在法律文本上的表現。調整後的模型 RuModernBERT-ruLaw 是在一個據報導包含 304,382 個立法文件和 194,425,905 個語料庫標記的語料上進行訓練的。語料標記計數與模型分詞器生成的位置區分開來。我們在一個固定的外部集合中比較原始和調整後的編碼器，該集合包含 1,031 個法院裁決片段。兩個模型在五個掩蔽實現中的每個隱藏位置都接收相同的輸入。在最大輸入長度為 512、2,048 和 8,192 標記時，平均掩蔽標記交叉熵分別減少了 0.10942、0.07052 和 0.06604 自然對數單位。報告的 95% 區間總結了對這個固定集合的掩蔽敏感性；它們並未量化跨文檔集合的不確定性。第二次評估針對法律實體提取。原始模型和調整後的模型達到了 0.99852 和 0.99820 的實體級 F1 分數。然而，99.95% 的測試跨度在訓練分割中具有相同的標準化表面形式和類別。因此，這次評估提供了有限的證據來支持對先前未見形式的轉移。本文解釋了掩蔽目標、重疊窗口、平均規則和使用可編輯圖表及清晰標記的示例進行的準確實體邊界評分。比較支持對所研究的模型和集合的較低掩蔽標記預測損失。它並未孤立遠程上下文的貢獻或確立實際法律效用。
